premises: Coarse-grained CoCrFeMnNi can dynamically amorphize under high shear during sliding wear
The resulting ultra-nanocrystalline/amorphous layer exhibits inverse Hall-Petch softening
This softening reduces effective shear strength, lowering friction and wear rates
The phenomenon is observed in inert environments (UHV) where oxidation is mitigated
